messages:
nina: Heads-up — planning kernel v3.14 + quant-build QF02 cutover tonight in the 23:00 PT quiet window. going to stage canary then ramp if smoke-green. want an explicit escape latch and pin TTL.
sam: +1. what's the pin TTL we want if we hit the thermal/latency spike?
ben: Recommend 2h pin TTL for regional hotfixes, 1h for night-only. keeps ops options tight.
eva: Agree on 1h for night. also add automatic fallback to v3.12-quant if avg p95 token latency > 350ms for 10m.
nina: ok set fallback threshold: p95 > 350ms sustained 10m -> auto-fallback to compatible variant. manual rollback if error rate > 0.8% over 5m.
opsbot: Deploy plan created: canary 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% over 90m. Canary region: us-west1.
deploybot: Scheduled deployment: kernel v3.14-QF02 to us-west1 at 2026-03-21T23:00:00-07:00. CID: db-deploy-176111.
sam: release notes bullets: 1) kernel v3.14 - matmul kernel reshape improves 4x small-batch throughput 2) quant QF02 - better int8 FP fallback on tail calls 3) fallback policy + pin TTL docs link. i'll draft.
ben: adding a short rollback runbook snippet to thread. keep it simple:
ben: ```
# Rollback quick steps
deploybot rollback --cid db-deploy-176111 --to-version v3.12-quant 
# verify: check p95, error-rate, kv-cache-hits on /metrics
```
eva: Also capture perf-snapshots before canary: run `perf-snap collect --cid db-deploy-176111 --tags nightly-release` and attach to PR.
opsbot: perf-snap started, snapshot id ps-176111-1. ETA 6m.
nina: good. who wants to own the release-note blurb and the postmortem checklist? sam for notes, ben for postmortem/checklist.
sam: i'll push notes to the release-notes repo and tag @docs for a quick pass.
ben: i'll own the postmortem checklist and observability playbook updates. will pre-create the alert thresholds we discussed.
deploybot: Canary started: 5% traffic -> 23:05 PT. monitor p95 and errors, will report status.
sam: monitoring now. dashboards: infra/runtime/p95, runtime/errors, kvcache/evictions. set alerts to page if error-rate > 1% for 5m.
eva: small ask: add a temporary routing rule to keep embedding-heavy customers on dedicated pool if they have strict SLAs. avoid mass regressions.
nina: noted — i'll create a routing override for known embedding routes for the first 60m.
opsbot: Canary health: p95=310ms, errors=0.12%, kv-evict normal. keeping canary.
deploybot: Canary ramping to 25% at 23:25 PT.
ben: if any region shows p95>350ms or errors>0.8% -> trigger auto-fallback for that region and @oncall-page.
sam: quick thumbs: :thumbsup: all good from my side.
eva: :thumbsup:
nina: thanks team. runbook pinned in thread. if anything flaps, use the rollback snippet above and ping #eng-oncall.
deploybot: Deployment complete: 100% traffic at 00:55 PT. Final status: success. metrics snapshot: p95=305ms, errors=0.14%.
